The answer is **B. 86%**. UNESCO data puts the global adult literacy rate (ages 15 and over) at about 86% in 2015, which leaves roughly 745 million adults unable to read or write. The team note doesn't match the data: literacy rose in most regions over recent decades, and about 14% of adults lacking literacy is fewer than one in five but not a decline to the low eighties.

CONFIDENCE: 90
